name: WP Suspension
note: MotoGP partner of Red Bull KTM (ktm.com partner logos). Left unrated: WP is a brand of the Bajaj Mobility group, about 74.9% owned by an indirect subsidiary of Bajaj Auto Ltd, India (wp-ktm-bajaj-ownership), but Bajaj Auto's own shareholders aren't sourced, so a state holding of 5% or more further up can't be ruled out.
